description: This file defines a static class 'ManageNavPages' that provides constants and helper methods for managing navigation page states and CSS classes in the Web UI of an ASP.NET Core MVC application. It helps identify the active page and apply appropriate styling.

classes.name: ManageNavPages
classes.description: A static utility class that manages navigation page states and CSS class assignments for the account management section of a web app.

methods.name: IndexNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class for the 'Index' page, indicating if it is active.

methods.name: ChangePasswordNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class for the 'ChangePassword' page, indicating if it is active.

methods.name: ExternalLoginsNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class for the 'ExternalLogins' page, indicating if it is active.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthenticationNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class for the 'TwoFactorAuthentication' page, indicating if it is active.

methods.name: PageNavClass
methods.description: Determines if the given page is the current active page and returns 'active' CSS class if so, otherwise an empty string.

methods.name: AddActivePage
methods.description: Extension method to set the active page in the ViewData dictionary.
